# The algebra generated by the matrices of central rational points

Author: Worker 1532.

Namespace: `Langlands.BruhatTits.RationalPoints.CentralNormKernel`. Internal helper for the
proof of `CentralNormKernelCompactnessStatement`. Let `K` be a field, `G` a group scheme over
`Spec K` and `ρ : MatrixRepresentation G N`. "Central" always means membership in the all-test
centre `(center G).carrier (Over.mk (𝟙 _))`.

- `centralMatrices ρ` is the set of matrices `ρ.rationalMatrix z` of central rational points;
  `rationalMatrix_mem_centralMatrices`, and `centralMatrices_commute` (central points commute
  with all points).
- `CentralAlgebra ρ` is the subalgebra `Algebra.adjoin K (centralMatrices ρ)`, made a
  commutative ring using `Algebra.isMulCommutative_adjoin`
  (`isMulCommutative_centralAlgebra`). `centralVal ρ` is its inclusion into matrices
  (`centralVal_injective`), and `centralElement ρ hz` is the element given by a central point
  (`centralVal_centralElement`).
- `commute_scalarMap_of_mem`: for `M` in the central algebra, every test scheme `T` and every
  `T`-point `g`, the matrix `M` pulled back to `Γ(T)` commutes with `ρ.pointMatrix T g`. By
  induction over `Algebra.adjoin`: for a generator `ρ(z)` this is centrality of `z` (with
  `pointMatrix_toBase`); scalars commute; sums and products preserve commutation.
- `mapMatrix_blockMatrix` and `ΓSpecIso_det_blockMatrix`: at a rational point the block matrix
  `blockMatrix ρ π` of the published `GroupScheme.Derived.CentralIntersection.BlockCharacter` is
  `ρ(x) π + (1 - π)`, and its determinant is `det (ρ(x) π + (1 - π))`.

For spectral data `D : SpectralData K (CentralAlgebra ρ)` (module `Decomposition`):

- `blockIdem D i` is the matrix of the idempotent `e i`;
  `completeOrthogonalIdempotents_blockIdem`, `blockIdem_mem`.
- `blockChar D i` is the published `blockCharacter` of the idempotent `blockIdem D i`, a
  homomorphism `G ⟶ 𝔾_m`; its hypothesis is supplied by `commute_scalarMap_of_mem`.
- `blockChar_eq_one_iff`: at a rational point `x`, `x ≫ blockChar D i = 1` if and only if
  `det (ρ(x) E i + (1 - E i)) = 1`.
- `centralVal_block`: `centralVal ρ (D.block x i) = centralVal ρ x * E i + (1 - E i)`, with
  `E i = blockIdem D i`.
